items.coder_A: gbm_only via 'WHO grade IV malignant glioma' without IDH (D27C)
items.reason: Inclusion requires 'New pathologically confirmed diagnosis of WHO grade IV malignant glioma' with no IDH requirement; D27C reads grade IV glioma without IDH as the historical name for glioblastoma, and only grade IV is eligible, so gbm_only.
'Malignant glioma' is qualified as 'WHO Grade IV' in the official title and inclusion, so it is not the unspecified high-grade case (cf. D30-R7, which excludes only when no grade 4 is stated).

note: Excluded before S5 in any case: phase NA (S3, phase_not_applicable). No drug is registered (procedures only: T2* MRI, blood collection), so S6 would also fail, with reason excluded_intervention_type under D31-C1 (clarified).

harmonisation.reason: The only interventions under test are diagnostic procedures (T2* MRI, standard MRI, biospecimen collection), and D31-C1 (clarified) uses excluded_intervention_type whenever a non-drug intervention is under test.
